<div class="paper-links"><a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3830948" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN</a> <button type="button" class="citation-link" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick="document.getElementById('citation-10').showModal()">APA citation</button></div>

<dialog class="citation-dialog" id="citation-10" onclick="if (event.target === this) this.close()">

<h4>APA citation</h4>
<form method="dialog"><button class="citation-close" aria-label="Close APA citation">×</button></form>
</div>
<p>Lin, D., Pavlov, A. D., Steiner, E., &amp; Wachter, S. M. (2021). REIT capital structure choices: When does preparation matter? SSRN Electronic Journal. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.3830948</p>
</div>
</dialog>

<details class="abstract-disclosure">
<summary>Abstract</summary>
<p>This paper uses the contrast between the predictable 2007–2009 financial crisis and the unexpected COVID-19 shock to test why pre-crisis REIT capital-structure adjustments matter. Leverage reduction and maturity extension predicted returns during the earlier crisis but not during the pandemic, supporting the interpretation that preparation for foreseeable events signals managerial quality.</p>
</details>

<div class="paper-meta">

</div>

### Housing Search and Rental Market Intermediation

<p class="paper-venue-line"><a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3714128" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN Electronic Journal</a>, 2020</p>

<div class="paper-links"><a href="https://www.desenlin.com/_files/ugd/c836e6_7fac1573d19c49318ddd9aeb1f2ddcfb.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Paper</a> <a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3714128" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN</a> <button type="button" class="citation-link" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick="document.getElementById('citation-11').showModal()">APA citation</button></div>

<dialog class="citation-dialog" id="citation-11" onclick="if (event.target === this) this.close()">
<div class="citation-dialog-content">
<div class="citation-dialog-heading">
<h4>APA citation</h4>
<form method="dialog"><button class="citation-close" aria-label="Close APA citation">×</button></form>
</div>
<p>Lin, D. (2020). Housing search and rental market intermediation. SSRN Electronic Journal. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.3714128</p>
</div>
</dialog>

<details class="abstract-disclosure">
<summary>Abstract</summary>
<p>Using listing-agent matched data from Manhattan, this paper studies how broker listing capacity affects rents and time on market. Larger brokers list at lower rents and achieve shorter durations, patterns not fully explained by housing amenities. A directed-search model links broker capacity constraints to tenant coordination frictions and evaluates brokerage entry and rules shifting commission liability from tenants to landlords.</p>
</details>

</div>

### Land Use Regulation, Regulatory Spillover and Housing Prices

<p class="paper-authors">with <a href="https://real-estate.wharton.upenn.edu/profile/wachter/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Susan Wachter</a> <span class="paper-affiliation">(University of Pennsylvania)</span></p>

<p class="paper-venue-line"><a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=3363947" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN Electronic Journal</a>, 2020</p>

<div class="paper-links"><a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=3363947" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN</a> <button type="button" class="citation-link" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick="document.getElementById('citation-12').showModal()">APA citation</button></div>

<dialog class="citation-dialog" id="citation-12" onclick="if (event.target === this) this.close()">
<div class="citation-dialog-content">
<div class="citation-dialog-heading">
<h4>APA citation</h4>
<form method="dialog"><button class="citation-close" aria-label="Close APA citation">×</button></form>
</div>
<p>Lin, D., &amp; Wachter, S. M. (2020). Land use regulation, regulatory spillover and housing prices. SSRN Electronic Journal. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.3363947</p>
</div>
</dialog>

<details class="abstract-disclosure">
<summary>Abstract</summary>
<p>Using California housing sales and a spatial-equilibrium model, this paper estimates how local land-use regulation affects housing prices directly through lower housing productivity and indirectly through household relocation across jurisdictions. It finds economically meaningful regulatory spillovers and shows that ignoring restrictions in surrounding locations can misstate local price effects.</p>
</details>

<div class="paper-meta">

</div>

### Housing Boom, Mortgage Default and Agency Friction

<p class="paper-venue-line"><a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3367554" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN Electronic Journal</a>, 2018</p>

<div class="paper-links"><a href="https://www.desenlin.com/_files/ugd/c836e6_bbdd6f5f7e7a4067b6d2b7d1490bd624.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Paper</a> <a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3367554" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">SSRN</a> <button type="button" class="citation-link" aria-haspopup="dialog" onclick="document.getElementById('citation-13').showModal()">APA citation</button></div>

<dialog class="citation-dialog" id="citation-13" onclick="if (event.target === this) this.close()">
<div class="citation-dialog-content">
<div class="citation-dialog-heading">
<h4>APA citation</h4>
<form method="dialog"><button class="citation-close" aria-label="Close APA citation">×</button></form>
</div>
<p>Lin, D. (2018). Housing boom, mortgage default and agency friction. SSRN Electronic Journal. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.3367554</p>
</div>
</dialog>

<details class="abstract-disclosure">
<summary>Abstract</summary>
<p>This paper documents rising mortgage delinquency alongside falling mortgage spreads before the Great Recession. A dynamic general-equilibrium model with borrowers, depositors, and constrained intermediaries decomposes the spread into liquidity and default components. The analysis indicates that relaxed intermediary lending constraints can explain simultaneous growth in mortgage credit and declining spreads, while intermediary leverage amplifies boom-bust dynamics.</p>
</details>

<div class="paper-meta">
<strong>Presentations</strong>
<span>Midwest Macroeconomics Meetings, Nashville, TN, 2018 · 13th Annual Economics Graduate Students Conference, Washington University in St. Louis, St. Louis, MO, 2018 · Penn Macro Lunch, University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, PA, 2018 · ASSA–AREUEA Doctoral Session, Atlanta, GA, 2019</span>
</div>
:::
